case_design.capability: F08: a single-user personal library persisted in SQLite that survives browser sessions and server restarts, with records queried from the database for every request rather than held in a browser store.
case_design.reason: The evidence shows Dexie writes on save/delete and a one-time db.bookmarks.toArray() hydration into an in-memory RippleMap, scoped to one browser profile with no sync. The target adopts local, single-user, cross-session retention but replaces IndexedDB/Dexie and in-memory hydration with SQLite on the Python server; it does not claim browser-profile persistence, multi-device sync, or the source map as target design.

case_design.capability: F11: the library is delivered as server-rendered HTML pages and forms with POST/redirect/GET for add, edit and organize actions, including a ready empty-library view.
case_design.reason: The evidence describes a client-mounted SPA: Edit is an in-page dialog populated from item fields, and component creation loads Dexie rows into a client RippleMap. The target renders lists, forms and empty state as Python 3.12 HTML responses, so the SPA mount, client-side dialog state and Dexie hydration are not carried over; only the save-now/find-later user loop is retained.

case_design.capability: A deliberate save creates a URL-anchored record with a stable id, derived hostname, createdAt and initial state, and later edits preserve the record identity and creation/visit fields.
case_design.reason: Evidence defines bm-prefixed UUID identity, hostname derivation, createdAt and default state, and preserves id/createdAt/visit fields on edit. The target adopts this record lifecycle as a user-facing capability, with SQLite providing durability; the source's free-text tag constraints are treated separately in the category decision, not silently imported as target rules.

case_design.capability: URL validation accepts only absolute, parseable HTTP(S) URLs with a nonempty valid hostname, allows single-label hosts such as http://localhost, preserves the original URL text, and rejects malformed, non-HTTP(S) or empty-host input without writing; no DNS or online-reachability check is performed.
case_design.reason: The upstream Valibot rule is a dotted-host regex that requires a dot-separated domain and an alphabetic top-level suffix, so it rejects localhost. That regex is retained as a source fact and mapped as adjusted, not reused as the target rule: the target parses the URL, checks the http/https scheme, absolute form and hostname presence, permits single-label hosts, and stores the entered string unchanged.

case_design.capability: Create, rename and delete named categories with validation and with protection or reassignment when a category still contains records, assign one at save time, move records between categories, and default uncategorized saves into an Inbox category.
case_design.reason: Evidence shows the source has no category entity: classification is only up to five free-text tags, there is no collection CRUD or separate move, and the form rejects saves with zero tags. The target therefore designs first-class categories, an inbox default for unclassified capture and an explicit move action; these are new target concepts, not source-derived tag behavior.

case_design.capability: Browse one category and see only its active records, with a category count that agrees with the listed records after adds, moves and restores.
case_design.reason: Source facts derive tag counts by scanning all in-memory bookmarks and filter records by requiring every selected tag. The target computes category counts and category-scoped lists in SQL over active, non-deleted rows so the count and the list stay consistent; the source tag-sidebar algorithm is not the target implementation.

case_design.capability: Search the selected category by keyword across title, hostname and description using case-insensitive substring matching, retaining category and query and rendering matching or explicit empty results.
case_design.reason: Source search lowercases and compares only bookmark.title; the fixed target F06/A07 contract adjusts it to title, derived hostname and description, combined with the selected category. Raw URL text, category names and tags are not additional keyword fields. This clarifies target design only; accepted observations, evidence IDs, source revision and disposition remain unchanged.

case_design.capability: Open a saved record as a navigation to its stored original URL, preserving the URL text and never fetching, proxying or prefetching the destination during save, listing or open preparation.
case_design.reason: Source opens the URL with window.open(url, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer') after updating visit state. The target renders the record URL as an ordinary HTTP(S) link or server redirect with the same new-tab/no-referrer intent; opening is a user navigation distinct from saving, and the Python server does not request the target page.

case_design.capability: Do not enrich saved records with third-party metadata or favicon services and do not prefetch saved target pages; stored title, description and URL come from the user or local derivation.
case_design.reason: The source calls api.microlink.io and images.weserv.nl/Google s2 favicons on save and treats failures as silent. The target P0 deliberately omits these outbound calls because saving and opening must remain distinct from fetching; no target-page response, metadata or icon is retrieved, and no source enrichment behavior is presented as target design.

case_design.capability: Soft-delete an active record into a recoverable trash and restore it later, instead of allowing deletion only on archived items with a transient toast undo.
case_design.reason: Source facts limit Delete to archived items and provide recovery only through an Undo action on the toast, with no trash view and no deletion path for active records. The target uses an explicit soft-delete/restore lifecycle exposed in HTML so records remain recoverable; this changes the source's archived-only and transient-recovery model.

# 架构与契约

## 默认技术栈与理由

- 交付 profile：python-web。Python 3.12 标准库（http.server、sqlite3、urllib、json、html.parser），零第三方依赖；服务端渲染 HTML 表单，JSON API 与 HTML 适配器共用同一服务层。
- 备选 Flask/FastAPI 需安装依赖；Node + IndexedDB/SPA 需 npm/浏览器工具且把数据放在浏览器 profile。二者与离线、可独立验收、单用户本地库的约束冲突，故不采用。
- 数据文件位于应用 `--data-dir/bookmarks.sqlite3`；验收的每实例隔离目录由测试适配器创建，测试者 `--data-dir` 根目录不是应用数据库。
- 单用户、本地优先；无认证、无云同步。日常绑定 127.0.0.1；仅隔离验收网络使用 0.0.0.0。

## 数据模型（SQLite）

- `schema_meta(version INTEGER)`：迁移版本单行。启动时在一个事务内创建/升级 schema，v1 建表并写入预置归类；版本演进只通过事务化迁移，不回退、不依赖客户端存储。
- `categories(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE, is_default INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, position INTEGER NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)`：首启预置「未整理」(is_default=1)、「待购」、「家居改造」、「以后看看」。
- `bookmarks(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, url TEXT NOT NULL, hostname TEXT NOT NULL, title TEXT NULL, description TEXT NULL, category_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES categories(id), favicon_url TEXT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, trashed_at INTEGER NULL)`。
- 索引：category_id、created_at、hostname；url 不设唯一索引。P1/F14 的重复检测由服务层查询活动记录完成；P0 不启用重复拒绝。
- trashed_at 为 NULL 表示活动记录；非 NULL 为软删除。默认列表与计数只统计 trashed_at IS NULL；恢复清空 trashed_at。删除归类在单一事务内把该归类下的活动记录与软删除记录都改到默认归类，因此恢复不会产生无归类记录。
- 排序固定为 created_at DESC、id ASC；category 与 q 只作请求参数，不落库。

## URL 策略

- 记录 URL 必须是绝对、可解析的 HTTP(S) URL，且 hostname 有效且非空。单标签主机（如 http://localhost）与 IP 字面量均有效；不做 DNS 查询、可达性检查或目标页抓取。
- 保存与打开都保留用户提交的原始字符串（不补斜杠、不改大小写、不重写路径）；hostname 由解析结果派生。若 PATCH 更新 URL，必须用新 URL 重新派生 hostname。
- 拒绝：缺少 scheme、非 http/https、缺少/非法 hostname、无法解析的字符串；返回 400 invalid_url 且不写入。
- 上游 S04 的点域名正则与 S08 getHostname 是源观察，映射为 adjusted：点不是通用 URL 有效性要求；target 采用上述解析策略。
- 保存、打开、抓取三者分离：P0 保存与列表均不请求目标页；打开只产生浏览器导航或 /go 302。

## API、错误与状态合同

- `GET /api/health` → 200 JSON，含就绪与 schema 版本。
- `GET /api/categories` → 200 数组，每项 id、name、count、is_default；count 只计活动记录。
- `POST /api/categories` name → 201；重名 409 duplicate_category；空名或超过 120 字符 400 invalid_name。
- `PATCH /api/categories/{id}` name → 200；同上校验；默认归类 400 protected_category。`DELETE /api/categories/{id}` → 200；默认归类 400 protected_category；否则事务内把活动与软删记录迁到默认归类。
- `GET /api/bookmarks?category=<name|id>&q=<str>&include_trashed=0|1` → 200 数组；默认排序 created_at DESC、id ASC；q 对标题、hostname、描述做大小写不敏感子串匹配并与 category 叠加；未知归类返回空数组。
- `POST /api/bookmarks` url 必填，title、description、category 可选，allow_duplicate 为 P1；201；category 省略/null 时归入默认「未整理」；显式空字符串或超过 120 字符 400 invalid_category；新名称按 NOCASE 自动创建并复用；非法 URL 400 invalid_url；P1 重复 409 duplicate_url 且附 existing_id。
- `GET /api/bookmarks/{id}` 200 或 404 not_found；`PATCH` 更新字段；URL 变化时重算 hostname；非法 URL 400 invalid_url，非法归类 400 invalid_category；P1 重复 409 duplicate_url。`POST /api/bookmarks/{id}/move` body category 必填；省略/空/超长 400 invalid_category；新名称自动创建。`DELETE /api/bookmarks/{id}` 软删除 200；`POST /api/bookmarks/{id}/restore` 恢复；P1 同 URL 活动冲突 409 duplicate_url 且不改数据。
- `GET /go/{id}` 302，Location 为保存时原始 URL；未知 id 404 not_found。HTML 打开链接使用原始 URL，target=_blank、rel=noopener。
- P1：`GET /api/export` Netscape HTML；`POST /api/import` 同格式，返回 imported/skipped。
- 错误合同：JSON 失败返回 `{error:{code,message,field}}`；通用 bad_request（畸形/不可解析 JSON，400）、invalid_url、invalid_category、invalid_name、not_found、duplicate_category、protected_category、duplicate_url。校验错误不产生 5xx，不产生部分写入；畸形 JSON 一律 bad_request 且不写。
- 状态合同：GET 幂等；写操作事务化；校验失败保持提交前状态；分类与 q 为视图状态；删除与恢复改变 trashed_at 但不删除行。

## UI/HTML 适配器合同（供真实表单验收与独立浏览器执行者）

- `GET /`：保存表单 `form[action=/bookmarks/new]`（method=post，字段 url/title/description/category；category 预填「未整理」）；`a[data-testid=category-manager]` 指向 /categories；`form[data-testid=category-search-form]` 为 GET /，含 select 或 input name=category（归类名）与 input name=q；记录行 `tr[data-testid=record-row][data-record-id]`；打开链接 `a[data-testid=record-open-link]` 的 href 必须等于保存时原始 URL，target=_blank，rel 含 noopener；每行含 `form[data-testid=record-move-form]`（input record_id、select name=category_id，值为 API 归类 ID）、`form[data-testid=record-delete-form]`（input record_id）；回收站或 `GET /?trash=1` 的软删记录行含 `form[data-testid=record-restore-form]`（input record_id）。
- `GET /categories`：`form[data-testid=category-create-form]`（input name）、`form[data-testid=category-rename-form]`（input category_id、name）、`form[data-testid=category-delete-form]`（input category_id）；每个归类行/侧栏计数为 `[data-testid=category-count][data-category-id=...]`，只显示活动记录数；归类名/计数与 JSON 一致。
- 表单成功：save 303 到 /?category=...；move 303 到目标归类；delete 303 到 /?trash=1；restore 303 到恢复后归类；category create/rename/delete 303 到 /categories。失败：400/409 渲染当前页，含 `[data-testid=form-error]` 可读消息，保留 url/title/description/category/name/category_id/record_id 中已提交的值，并保留可重新提交的表单；不得 5xx 或写入。
- 归类搜索：提交 category 与 q，成功后 URL 与表单同时保留两者；页面显示所选归类、保留的查询和匹配行；同一关键字在两个归类分别得到各自结果；某归类无匹配时显示明确空结果，不是错误。
- 记录移动由 HTML 适配器把 category_id 翻译成归类名，再调用现有 move 服务；归类删除仍按 API 事务迁移活动与软删记录。默认归类不可重命名/删除。
- P0 不提供孤立的记录编辑界面；仅保留 PATCH /api/bookmarks/{id} 的现有 URL 更新合同（URL 变化重算 hostname）。打开链接的实际导航目标由 href 与 /go 302 双重验证，不抓取目标页。

## 验收适配器合同

- 全部程序使用 `--base-url` 指向真实 python-web 目标；A01/A05/A09 另需 `--app-root` 与 `--data-dir`，A14 需 `--data-dir`。
- `--app-root` 只读；`--data-dir` 是测试者草稿根。重启用例通过 common.launch_app 在同一 `--data-dir/instances/<id>` 上启动 `app/serve.py`，真实写入、SIGTERM、同一目录重启并读回；健康检查不是重启证据。
- HTML 用例以标准库 urllib 提交 application/x-www-form-urlencoded 表单并解析响应 HTML 的 data-testid、表单字段、链接与文本；不以 API 调用代替声明的 HTML 表单，不驱动 JS/DOM。独立浏览器执行者可复用同一契约。
- 所有请求限定在 base_url 精确 origin；/go 不跟随重定向；不请求保存的外链、元数据或 favicon；不附加凭据；目标要求认证时显式报告基础设施未就绪。
- 结果：stdout 单个 atlas.acceptance-result.v1 JSON；断言失败或基础设施错误 exit nonzero；不声称已运行。

## 非功能需求

- 离线可用：保存/浏览/检索不依赖外部服务；不设置外部抓取为 P0 要求。
- 数据完整性：写事务化；归类删除与恢复保持引用完整；校验失败零写入。
- 确定性：排序、错误码、重定向稳定；GET 幂等。
- 可访问/可测试：语义化 HTML、表单 label 或 aria、稳定 data-testid；服务端输出 UTF-8。
- 单用户本机：无认证；日常 127.0.0.1，0.0.0.0 仅隔离验收网络。
- 不设未经验证的时延/吞吐/成本目标；只要求请求可顺序处理。

## 边界与限制

- 不实现云同步、多设备、协作、分享、浏览器扩展/移动分享目标。
- 不保存网页副本、不抓取正文、不做失效链接检测（F17/F18）。
- 不引入置顶/归档/多排序/复制 URL/访问计数（F20/F23/F24）。
- 归类为扁平单选；嵌套/标签属后期（F19/D12）。
- P0 不做重复拒绝；F14/A15 保持 P1。
- 第三方元数据/图标仅 P1 可选增强，失败不影响保存；离线验收不验证其可达性。

## A04/A12 分类输入澄清（本次受限修订）

- A04 仅分类管理：HTML create/rename 表单的 name 与 JSON create/rename 的 name 同为归类名称；省略、空字符串、纯空白、121 字符均 400 invalid_name，JSON 显式 null 同样 invalid_name。既有重名 duplicate_category、默认分类 protected_category、删除迁移/恢复均保留。
- A12 仅书签保存和移动，不将分类管理 name 校验混为 invalid_category。HTML 保存使用名称 category；省略时未整理，显式空/纯空白/121 字符为 400 invalid_category。HTML 无 JSON null 这种原生值，不能把字面字符串 null 当 JSON null。
- JSON 保存使用名称 category；省略或显式 null 均默认未整理，显式空/纯空白/121 字符为 invalid_category。JSON move 的名称 category 必填；省略、null、空/纯空白/121 字符为 invalid_category。有效新名称可自动创建并复用，未知名称不等于非法 ID。
- HTML move 使用 category_id（API 已有分类 ID），必须解析为已有名称再调用服务；省略、空或未知 ID 为 invalid_category，不能把未知 ID 当新名称创建。JSON 保存/move 合同不新增 category_id 字段；GET category 未知值的空结果语义不改。
- 错误分支一律零写入：HTML 400、form-error 可读、保留已提交字段并提供可重试表单；JSON 400、error.code/message/field，无导航。成功流程、303 导航、阶段、能力与既有断言意图保留。
- 搜索仍仅对 title、hostname、description 做大小写不敏感子串匹配，并叠加分类；不扩展为 URL 全文、分类名或标签检索。此处对齐目标设计，不更改案例来源观察。

features.action: 填写原始 URL，可选标题/描述，选择已有归类、留为默认「未整理」或输入新归类名并提交。
features.design_basis: 场景 workflow 1–2 与验收 1/2：用户主动保存外部网页链接，记录以 URL 锚定并持久保留。
features.entry: 首页 GET / 的保存表单 form[action=/bookmarks/new]，字段 url、title、description、category。
features.failure: 非法 URL 返回 400 invalid_url，非法归类返回 400 invalid_category；HTML 同页显示 [data-testid=form-error]，不写入。
features.navigation: 成功后 303 到 /?category=<归类> 或 /，浏览器显示新记录行。
features.recovery: 失败页保留已填 url/title/description/category，用户修正后重新提交；也可返回列表。
features.success_state: 303 返回首页，新记录出现在所选归类，GET /api/bookmarks/{id} 返回同一原始 URL；SQLite 行已持久化。

features.action: 不另选归类直接保存；首启查看预置归类。
features.design_basis: 场景 workflow 3：未经整理的链接先进入默认归类，之后再移动；成熟产品普遍提供未被整理收件区。
features.entry: 首页保存表单的 category 字段（默认「未整理」）与侧栏/归类页的预置归类列表。
features.failure: 默认归类缺失或写入失败时返回明确错误页或 JSON 错误，不伪装成功。
features.navigation: 303 到首页或未整理归类视图。
features.recovery: 重试保存；应用启动时在事务中补齐预置归类。
features.success_state: 记录的 category_id 为默认「未整理」，可在 /?category=未整理 看到；“未整理”“待购”“家居改造”“以后看看”均可见。

features.action: 在真实表单提交 name 新建/重命名，提交 category_id 删除；删除默认归类被拒绝。
features.design_basis: 场景验收 3 与 workflow 2：用户可新建归类并把记录放入合适位置；源包没有 collections，属目标新设计。
features.entry: 首页 a[data-testid=category-manager] 进入 /categories；该页含 category-create-form、category-rename-form、category-delete-form。
features.failure: 重名 409 duplicate_category、空名/超长 400 invalid_name、默认归类 400 protected_category；页面显示 form-error 且数据不变。
features.navigation: 创建/重命名/删除成功后 303 到 /categories。
features.recovery: 保留已填 name/category_id 并允许改正或选择其他归类；可返回 /categories 重试。
features.success_state: 303 到 /categories；新建/重命名可见且计数正确；删除归类后其活动与软删除记录都迁回「未整理」，软删记录仍可恢复。

features.action: 选择目标归类（API 归类 ID）并提交；HTML 适配器把 ID 翻译为归类名后调用现有 move 服务。
features.design_basis: 场景验收 3 与 workflow 3：记录可在归类之间移动，重新打开后仍保持新归属。
features.entry: 每条 tr[data-testid=record-row] 内的 form[data-testid=record-move-form]，含 input record_id 与 select name=category_id。
features.failure: 空/超长/非法归类 400 invalid_category，未知 record_id 404 not_found；不移动、不写入。
features.navigation: 成功后 303 到 /?category=<目标归类> 或来源视图。
features.recovery: 保留选择并显示 form-error；用户改选有效归类或返回列表重试。
features.success_state: 303 回列表；记录离开原归类并出现在目标归类，JSON 的 category 与持久化结果一致。

features.action: 点击归类链接或从搜索表单选择归类并查看列表。
features.design_basis: 场景验收 4：用户通过归类浏览找回记录；来源标签计数被调整为按归类聚合。
features.entry: 首页侧栏 [data-testid=category-count][data-category-id] 与归类链接；/categories 同显计数；GET /?category=<name>。
features.failure: 未知归类返回空结果而非 5xx；计数查询失败显示错误页。
features.navigation: GET /?category=... 或 GET /categories；无记录时显示明确空状态。
features.recovery: 选择其他归类或清空筛选。
features.success_state: 页面只列该归类活动记录；HTML count 与 JSON count 都等于活动（未软删）记录数；移动、删除、恢复后仍一致。

features.action: 选择归类、输入关键字并提交。
features.design_basis: 场景验收 4：用户凭记得的关键字找回已存链接；来源仅搜标题，目标扩展到可识别来源的字段。
features.entry: 首页 form[data-testid=category-search-form]，字段 category（归类名）与 q；action 为 GET /。
features.failure: 无匹配不是错误（200 + 空结果）；非法请求返回可读错误且不写入。
features.recovery: 修改 q 或切换归类重新提交；清空 q 恢复归类浏览。
features.success_state: URL 与表单保留 category 与 q；页面显示所选归类、保留查询和匹配行；同一关键字在两个归类分别命中各自记录；无匹配显示明确空结果；JSON 返回匹配集。

features.design_basis: 场景验收 2 与 workflow 5：打开记录即回到保存时的外部网页，库只保证引用而非内容。
features.entry: 记录行 a[data-testid=record-open-link] 与 GET /go/{id}。
features.failure: 未知 id 404 not_found；目标不可达不影响库中记录可读。
features.navigation: 浏览器导航到原始 URL（新标签）；服务端只发 302。
features.recovery: 返回收藏列表选择其他记录；如 URL 有误，可由现有 PATCH API 更新并重算 hostname。
features.success_state: 链接 href 恰为保存时原始 URL，target=_blank、rel 含 noopener；GET /go/{id} 302 Location 为同一字符串；P0 不请求目标页。

features.action: 执行真实写操作，停止应用进程，再以同一实例目录重启并读取。
features.design_basis: 场景验收 1：主动保存的链接在多次会话之间持久保留；目标以 SQLite 实现本地单用户持久化。
features.entry: 保存、移动、删除/恢复等写操作后重新请求页面；重启适配器从同一 app_root 与实例数据目录启动。
features.failure: 数据库不可写或损坏时返回明确 5xx 错误页而非成功假象；事务回滚保持旧状态。
features.navigation: 无自动导航；下次 GET / 读取持久状态。
features.recovery: 恢复可写数据目录后重试；重启应用重新初始化 schema。
features.success_state: 重启后 id、原始 URL、标题、描述、归类与 trashed 状态与写入后一致；HTML 与 JSON 都来自 SQLite。

features.action: 提交 record_id 软删除；在回收站提交 record_id 恢复。
features.design_basis: 场景要求可恢复的失败；来源仅有归档记录的瞬时 Undo，目标改为显式软删除与恢复。
features.entry: 记录行 form[data-testid=record-delete-form]；GET /?trash=1 的软删记录行 form[data-testid=record-restore-form]。
features.failure: 未知 record_id 404 not_found；失败不改变 trashed_at，不产生 5xx。
features.navigation: 删除成功 303 到 /?trash=1；恢复成功 303 到恢复后归类。
features.recovery: 回收站提供可提交的恢复表单；失败可重试或返回列表。
features.success_state: 默认视图与计数排除软删记录，回收站仍显示；恢复后原始字段与归类回归并重新可见；归类删除后软删记录仍在「未整理」可恢复。

features.action: 提交非法 URL、空/超长/非法归类、畸形 JSON 或未知 ID。
features.design_basis: 场景要求非法输入可恢复；源表单校验被调整为服务端 HTML 表单与 JSON API 共用的显式错误合同。
features.entry: 所有 HTML 表单（保存、归类、移动、删除、恢复、搜索）与 JSON API 端点。
features.failure: 出现 5xx、静默写入或不可恢复的错误页即视为失败。
features.navigation: HTML 错误留在当前表单页并保留输入；JSON 无导航。
features.recovery: 修正字段后重新提交；失败页保留可运行的表单或返回链接。
features.success_state: 错误路径本身成功执行：JSON 返回 400/404/409 与结构化错误码，HTML 返回 400/409 与 form-error；畸形 JSON 为 bad_request；均无 5xx、无写入。

features.action: 首启或空库时打开首页。
features.design_basis: 场景是单用户本地工具，需要可打开的应用入口；目标采用 Python 服务端渲染外壳而非来源 SPA。
features.failure: 健康检查非 200/非 JSON、首页 5xx 或缺少表单时显式失败。
features.navigation: 无自动导航（首页即入口）；可进入 /categories 或归类筛选。
features.recovery: 启动或重启应用；修复后刷新首页。
features.success_state: 200 text/html；含保存表单 name=url、归类管理链接、记录列表/空状态容器；预置归类与空库不报错；health 200 JSON。

decisions.default: 单选归类（bookmark.category_id 标量外键）。场景流程明确“选择一个简单归类”，单归属让移动、计数与浏览语义无歧义；未来若需多值可迁移到关联表而不丢数据。
decisions.impact: 决定数据模型（标量外键 vs 关联表）以及浏览、计数与检索的实现路径。
decisions.question: 记录应归属于单一“归类”，还是允许像标签一样同时属于多个？
decisions.when_to_ask: 当真实用户反馈同一条记录必须同时属于多个主题，或需要跨主题交叉检索时再评估多标签。

decisions.default: 落入默认“未整理”，保存始终成功。场景流程第3步要求未经整理的链接可先进入默认归类，快速保存不应打断浏览。
decisions.impact: 决定保存接口是否允许缺省 category，以及首启预置数据内容。
decisions.question: 保存时不选归类，应阻止保存还是落入默认“未整理”？
decisions.when_to_ask: 当目标用户群要求强制归类（例如团队共享库）时再改为必选。

decisions.default: 自动创建（名称大小写不敏感去重），重名则复用现有归类；保持保存流程不中断。
decisions.impact: 决定 categories 的唯一约束、写入事务边界与 409/400 的语义；HTML 归类表单与 JSON API 共用服务层，重名、非法名与默认归类保护都不得产生部分写入。
decisions.question: 在保存或移动界面输入一个尚不存在的归类名，应自动创建还是报错？
decisions.when_to_ask: 当出现拼写错误导致归类碎片化的证据时，改为只允许从既有归类中选择。

decisions.default: 软删除：记录标记 trashed_at，默认视图排除，提供撤销恢复；场景要求可恢复的失败。
decisions.impact: 决定数据模型的 trashed_at 列、默认列表过滤条件、/restore 恢复路径，以及删除归类时活动与软删记录同迁默认归类；不引入 purge 或永久删除接口。
decisions.question: 删除是立即物理删除，还是软删除到可恢复区并支持短时撤销？
decisions.when_to_ask: 当用户要求彻底清除隐私数据或回收站增长需要释放空间时，再提供永久删除与清空。

decisions.default: 本地优先：图标由域名派生本地路由，第三方元数据抓取为可选增强且失败静默降级，保证离线可保存。
decisions.impact: 决定保存流程的时延与可用性依赖，以及收藏响应中的 favicon/title 字段形态。
decisions.question: 标题、描述与图标是否依赖第三方抓取服务？
decisions.when_to_ask: 当部署环境确认可访问外部服务且用户需要富预览时再启用增强。

decisions.default: 自 P1/F14 起默认检测并返回 409 duplicate_url（附已有 id 供跳转查看），保存方显式 allow_duplicate 时可强制新增；P0 核心用例不依赖去重，软删除记录不参与判定；场景与成熟产品都倾向一址一记录。
decisions.impact: 决定服务层去重查询、allow_duplicate 语义与导入时的合并或跳过策略（不使用 url 唯一索引）。
decisions.question: 同一 URL 再次保存时，阻止还是允许？
decisions.when_to_ask: 当用户明确需要对同一地址保留多个不同上下文的记录时再放宽。

decisions.default: 标题加域名(hostname)加描述，大小写不敏感，可与归类过滤叠加；不检索正文（无抓取）。
decisions.impact: 决定查询实现与检索参数语义：category 与 q 可叠加，HTML 归类检索表单必须同时保留两者；计数与列表只统计未软删记录，移动、删除、恢复后保持一致。
decisions.question: 关键字应匹配哪些字段？
decisions.when_to_ask: 当需要按网页正文全文检索时再引入抓取与索引（属后期能力）。

decisions.default: python-web 加 Python 3.12 标准库 http.server 加单文件 SQLite；满足离线、单用户与可独立验收，无需外部依赖。
decisions.impact: 决定交付 profile 为 python-web（Python 3.12 标准库 + SQLite + 服务端渲染 HTML），验收通过独立 HTTP 实例与真实表单提交进行。
decisions.question: 采用何种运行时与持久化方式？
decisions.when_to_ask: 当需要多用户、并发写入或托管部署时再引入 Web 框架与服务端数据库。

decisions.default: 默认无认证；交付进程在独立验收网络中监听测试者可路由的接口（`--host 0.0.0.0`），日常本机使用可绑定 127.0.0.1；不引入凭据文件，符合个人本地库的定位。
decisions.impact: 决定部署方式与验收的认证契约（验收默认不携带凭据）。
decisions.question: 是否需要登录或口令？
decisions.when_to_ask: 当应用需要暴露到局域网或公网时，必须加入认证，否则只允许本机绑定。

decisions.default: Netscape 浏览器书签 HTML（本类型的交换约定），归类映射为文件夹或标签字段。
decisions.impact: 决定 P1 导入/导出的解析与生成实现。
decisions.question: 导入/导出采用什么格式？
decisions.when_to_ask: 当需要与某个具体产品双向同步时再适配其专有格式。

decisions.default: P0 不做：本地单实例，数据在单一 SQLite 文件；跨设备属后期能力。
decisions.impact: 影响运行形态与数据归属，不阻塞 P0 核心旅程。
decisions.question: 是否提供云同步或多用户共享？
decisions.when_to_ask: 当用户明确需要在多设备访问同一库时再设计同步或托管。

decisions.default: P0 使用扁平单选归类加“未整理”收件区；嵌套与标签属成熟能力，按需在后期启用。
decisions.impact: 影响侧栏结构与检索实现，可后续迁移而不破坏现有数据。
decisions.question: 归类是否需要嵌套层级，或与标签并存？
decisions.when_to_ask: 当扁平归类数量增长到难以浏览，或需要交叉主题时。

decisions.default: 本期不做：抓取与归档在离线验收下不可验证；先保证引用记录与打开回跳。
decisions.impact: 涉及外部抓取与存储扩展，属后期可选能力，不纳入 P0/P1 验收。
decisions.question: 是否需要保存网页副本并检测失效链接？
decisions.when_to_ask: 当用户明确要求内容留存，或需要清理死链时再评估。

features.name: 保存收藏（URL 必填，标题/描述可选）
features.reason: 场景流程第1-2步要求看到想记住的页面即主动保存；上游记录了新记录默认字段与保存落盘（S02、S06），并把 URL 校验与编辑回填收敛在表单（S04）。

features.name: 默认“未整理”与预置归类集合
features.reason: 场景流程第3步要求未整理的链接先进入默认归类；上游只有 Home/Archived 视图、无默认桶（S16），故按场景新增默认收件区，并借鉴其标签聚合思路（S20）。

features.name: 归类管理（新建/重命名/删除）
features.reason: 场景验收第3条要求可新建归类；上游明确没有 collections/folders（S16），因此归类实体与增删改必须新设计并落库。

features.name: 记录在归类间移动
features.reason: 场景验收第3条要求记录可在归类之间移动且重开后仍有效；上游检索按标签交集筛选（S16），这里把多值交集改造为单一归属迁移。

features.name: 归类浏览与条目计数
features.reason: 场景验收第4条要求通过归类浏览找回；上游侧栏按标签聚合计数（S20、S16），改为按归类聚合与筛选。

features.name: 关键字检索（标题/域名/描述）
features.reason: 场景验收第4条要求关键字检索；上游仅匹配标题小写（S16），需扩展到域名与描述以覆盖只记得来源的场景。

features.name: 打开原始网页（URL 锚定与回跳）
features.reason: 场景验收第2条与流程第5步要求打开记录即回到原页；上游 Visit 以 window.open(noopener,noreferrer) 打开并由 URL 派生域名（S15、S08），保留打开与派生、去掉访问计数。

features.name: 多会话持久化（跨重启保留）
features.reason: 场景验收第1条要求多次会话之间持久保留；源包以 Dexie/IndexedDB 落盘并在启动时全量载入（S09、S13、S06），README 定位 local-first（S11）。目标保留本地单用户与跨会话/跨重启持久化的行为，但把存储实现调整为 Python 服务端 SQLite：不宣称浏览器 profile 持久化、多设备同步或客户端内存映射是目标设计；每个请求从数据库查询。

features.name: 删除与撤销恢复
features.reason: 场景要求可恢复的失败；上游删除配 5 秒 Undo 恢复（S07），去掉“仅归档可删”前置限制，保留删除加恢复的兜底。

features.name: 输入校验与错误合同
features.reason: 上游以 Valibot 约束 http/https、标题长度与标签数量（S04），并由 getHostname 派生域名（S08）；场景把标签必填改为可选归类，需要显式错误的保存与移动契约。

features.name: 本地应用外壳与首启（空库）

leaf.content:
# Bookmark Manager

## Overview

A **Bookmark Manager** is a personal library application for the web: it saves references to web resources as durable records, organizes them under the user's control, and makes them findable later so the user can return to those resources.

The defining core is small:

```text
Deliberately saved reference record
└── anchored to an external web resource by its address (URL)
    └── held in a persistent, accumulating personal library
        └── under user-controlled organization
            └── retrieved later to return to the resource
```

Everything else commonly associated with the category — browser extensions, automatic metadata, tags and nested collections, cloud sync, duplicate and broken-link management, preserved copies of pages, public sharing — is standard equipment of mature modern products rather than what makes the product a bookmark manager. Older and platform-native forms of the same idea (a browser's built-in bookmark folders, the tag-only social bookmarking services of the mid-2000s) satisfy the core without any of those features.

The essential job is **save now, find later**. When the center of gravity shifts to consuming captured content (a reading queue), publishing collections for an audience, or storing user-authored material, the product is drifting toward a different Application Type (Read-it-later, Content Curation, or Note-taking respectively).

## Users & Context

The primary user is an individual who encounters web resources faster than they can act on them: articles, tools, documentation, references, inspiration, things to buy, things to revisit. They save deliberately — each record exists because the person chose to keep that page — and return weeks, months, or years later.

Typical reasons to open the application:

- save a page just encountered, in one click, without losing browsing flow
- put a saved page where it belongs (topic, project, list)
- find "that page I saw a while ago" by remembering a word, a tag, or roughly where it was filed
- return to a specific known resource (a tool, a reference, a recipe) instead of searching the web for it again
- clean house: remove dead links, merge duplicates, restructure

Secondary contexts: small teams or groups maintaining shared collections (research, reading lists, project links); public sharing of a curated list when the owner chooses to. The work environment is inherently multi-device — the whole point of a standalone library is that it is not trapped in one browser or one machine.

## Core Model

### The Defining Core

Four properties. If any one is removed, the product is no longer recognizable as a bookmark manager:

- **Reference record anchored to an address** — the central object is a record that points at a web resource via its URL, enriched with whatever metadata the product adds. The record is not the content; the content lives on the web, outside the library. This is what separates the Type from notes (authored content) and from read-it-later services (the captured readable copy is the working object).
- **Deliberate capture** — every record originates from a user decision to save (a click, a share, a pasted URL, an approved import). Nothing is logged automatically. This is what separates the library from browser history.
- **Persistent, accumulating personal library** — records survive sessions and devices and pile up over time into a long-lived personal asset, often numbering thousands of items.
- **User-controlled organization and retrieval** — the user structures the library in some form and can find records again by browsing that structure and/or by searching. The *form* of organization is an implementation choice, not part of the definition.

### The Record

A bookmark record typically carries:

- the resource's URL — the anchor and, in most products, the record's identity
- title and description (fetched from the page automatically in many modern products, and user-editable everywhere)
- a preview thumbnail or icon
- organizational assignments: collections/folders and/or tags
- timestamps, favorite/pinned flags, and free-form notes in many products

Concept versus implementation — the core concepts are realized differently across products:

```text
Concept:             Saved reference record
Implementations:     link with metadata (universal); record plus preserved page copy;
                     uploaded file kept as a library item (some products)

Concept:             User-controlled organization
Implementations:     hierarchical folders/collections; tags; favorites/pins;
                     manual ordering; an "unsorted" inbox for uncategorized saves

Concept:             Retrieval
Implementations:     search over titles/URLs/descriptions/tags (full-text over page
                     content in some products); browse by collection or tag; filters; sort
```

### Capabilities Shared by Mature Products

These are standard in current standalone products. They make the library practical but do not define the Type:

- **Capture machinery** — a browser extension or bookmarklet (save from any page without leaving it), a mobile share-sheet target, a manual "add URL" form, and bulk import from browsers or other services.
- **Metadata enrichment** — automatic extraction of title, description, and preview imagery from the saved page; editable by the user.
- **Layered organization** — nested collections/folders and/or tags, often both; favorites or pinned items; a landing zone (unsorted/inbox) for saves the user hasn't classified yet.
- **Retrieval machinery** — search across the library, filters (by tag, type, date), sorting (newest-first is the common default), and bulk edit tools for reorganizing at scale.
- **Multi-device, multi-browser access** — web, desktop, and mobile clients sharing one library; independence from any single browser profile is the reason standalone products exist.
- **Interoperability** — import/export in the standard browser-bookmark HTML format, which functions as the Type's interchange convention.
- **Library hygiene** — duplicate detection or prevention; awareness of broken links (detection or error listings). Common in standalone products, though depth varies.
- **Preservation copies** — a saved snapshot of the page (local file, vendor-hosted copy, or a third-party web archive) so the content survives even if the original disappears. Common in dedicated standalone products; absent from the Type's older and platform-native forms, and therefore not part of the definition.
- **Private-first sharing** — the library defaults to private; sharing a single link, a collection, or the whole account is an explicit, optional act.
- **Read-later affordances** — unread flags, clean reader views, reminders. A common hybrid overlap with Read-it-later, not part of the definition.

## How It Works

### Capture

```text
Encounter a page (in a browser or app)
→ invoke the save surface (extension / share sheet / add form)
→ the product creates a record: URL + fetched title, description, preview
→ optionally pick a collection and add tags at save time
→ done — the record is in the library
```

Capture is designed to cost seconds. If the user skips classification, the record lands in an unsorted area to be triaged later. Bulk capture exists in both directions: import brings an existing bookmark file or another service's library in at once, and some products can capture all open browser tabs in one action.

### Organize

```text
Open the unsorted area (or any collection)
→ assign records to collections, apply or clean up tags
→ restructure: nest, rename, merge, or reorder collections
→ bulk operations move or relabel many records at once
```

Organization is retroactive and continuously editable — records can be re-filed at any time, and the organizational structure itself (unlike a file system) is usually cheap to reshape because records are small.

### Find and return

```text
Remember something about the record (a word, a tag, the topic)
→ search, or browse to the collection/tag
→ scan result list (newest-first, or filtered/sorted)
→ open the record → click through to the live resource
```

Retrieval is the loop the whole Type exists for. Results are the user's own records; the product finds things the user has already seen and chosen to keep — the inverse of a search engine, which finds things the user has never seen.

### Maintain

```text
Periodically: run duplicate review → merge or remove
→ check broken-link reports → repair (find replacement) or delete
→ optionally trigger/request preserved copies of important records
→ deleted records go to a recoverable trash in some products
```

Because the referenced content lives on the web and out of the application's control, maintenance is a permanent background concern of this Type — link rot is structural, not an edge case.

## Interfaces

### Library list (home)

The primary surface: the accumulated records in a browsable list.

- typical information: title, URL/source, thumbnail, tags, collection, date added
- primary actions: open record, edit, move, tag, favorite, delete, select-many for bulk actions

### Capture surface

A small overlay, not a full screen: the browser-extension popup, the mobile share target, or the add form.

- typical information: page URL and fetched title/preview
- primary actions: save, pick collection, add tags, (sometimes) set reminder

### Collection / organization sidebar

The library's structural map.

- typical information: collection tree (often nestable), tag list or cloud, special views (unsorted, favorites, trash)
- primary actions: create/rename/nest/merge/delete collections, browse into one

### Record detail / edit

One record's full surface.

- typical information: URL, title, description, preview, notes, tags, collection, timestamps; sometimes the preserved copy or an embedded reader view
- primary actions: edit fields, move/recategorize, open original, preserve copy, delete

### Search and filters

- typical information: query field, filter controls (tag, type, date), result list
- primary actions: search, refine, act on results

### Trash

Where deletions land in products that offer recovery; excluded from search and normal views until restored or purged.

## Important Rules / Behaviors

- **The record points; the web owns the content.** A saved page can change or vanish without the record knowing. The library guarantees the *reference*, not the *content* — unless the product also stores a preserved copy, which is an optional capability.
- **The library grows only by user action.** Capture is deliberate. Imports and automated intake (e.g., configured feeds) enlarge the library only because the user set them up. There is no silent accumulation as with browser history.
- **Organization is user-controlled and always revisable.** No structure is imposed by the system; tags and collections mean what the user wants them to mean, and records can be re-filed indefinitely.
- **One resource, generally one record.** Mature products converge on a single record per address — either by preventing duplicates outright or by surfacing them for cleanup — but the strictness varies by product.
- **Private by default.** The library is personal; visibility to others requires an explicit sharing act (a public link, a per-record flag, or an invited member).
- **Deletion is often recoverable, but not always.** Some products hold deleted records in a trash area; others delete permanently, especially in bulk operations.
- **Read-later state, where present, is orthogonal to organization.** A record can be organized and still unread; the unread flag describes the user's relationship to the content, not the record's place in the library.

## Variants

- **Cloud consumer product** — hosted service with free and paid tiers, full client surface (web/desktop/mobile/extension), preservation and advanced search commonly reserved for paying users.
- **Minimal paid archive** — deliberately feature-light, text-first, tag-based; longevity and full-content archiving as the value proposition.
- **Self-hosted open source** — the user runs the server; data ownership and privacy as the value proposition; feature depth varies from minimal to preservation-heavy.
- **Team/collaborative library** — shared collections with invited contributors; positioned for research groups, agencies, and content teams.
- **Social bookmarking** (historical founding variant) — public-by-default saving with follower networks and discovery pages; private libraries later became the dominant posture.
- **Visual/moodboard style** — grid and mosaic presentations of previews, favored for design inspiration use.
- **Reader-centric hybrid** — strong reader views, annotations, and unread queues; overlaps Read-it-later significantly.
- **Browser feature vs standalone product** — the same core exists inside browsers; the standalone Type is distinguished by browser independence and library-scale management (see below).

## Related Application Types

| Application Type | Relationship | Distinction |
|---|---|---|
| Read-it-later Application | closest sibling | its center of gravity is the consumption queue: content is captured to be read and cleared; a bookmark manager's center is the retrievable reference kept in an organized library |
| Web Browser (built-in bookmarking) | same core, different scope | a browser bookmark feature is bound to one browser profile and offers no library-scale search, hygiene, preservation, or sharing; the standalone Type exists precisely to be browser-independent |
| Note-taking / Personal Knowledge Management Application | adjacent | notes center on user-authored content; a bookmark record is a pointer with metadata; PKM tools that save links are absorbing a capability, not becoming this Type |
| Feed Reader | adjacent | a feed reader subscribes to streams — items arrive automatically and continuously; the bookmark manager holds deliberate one-off captures |
| Content Curation Platform | adjacent, audience-facing | curation platforms publish collections for an audience as the primary job; the bookmark manager is private-first with sharing as an option |
| Reference Manager | specialized sibling | scholarly records with citation metadata and bibliographic output; the general bookmark manager has neither |
| Reading Library Application | family sibling | a library of readable content objects (books/documents) consumed in-app, rather than references whose content stays on the web |
| General Web Search Engine | functional opposite | a search engine finds resources the user has never seen; a bookmark manager retrieves resources the user has already seen and saved |

The boundary that matters most in practice is with **Read-it-later**: products hybridize heavily (reader views, unread flags appear on both sides). The structural test is the center of gravity — an organized library meant to be kept and searched, versus a queue meant to be consumed and emptied.

## Representative Products

- **Raindrop.io** — modern cloud-first product; collections + tags, automatic metadata, reader view, duplicate/broken-link tools, preserved copies, sharing and collaboration
- **Pinboard** — minimal paid web service (since 2009), tag-based, with a paid archival tier; explicit heir of the social-bookmarking lineage
- **Linkding** — self-hosted, minimal, metadata-fetching, snapshot-capable
- **Linkwarden** — self-hostable, preservation-first, with collaboration and reader/annotation layers

The defining core was also checked against the Type's other historical forms — browser-native bookmark folders and the tag-only social bookmarking services of the 2000s — to avoid defining the category solely by today's cloud-and-preservation products.
